listings.title: Romans 8, slowly
listings.description: What I noticed reading it over a month

preview.excerpt: Verses 1–11 There is therefore now no condemnation. I have read that line for years as a verdict handed down at a distance. This month it read as something closer — a door held open by someone standing in it. The chapter...
preview.bodyHtml:
Verses 1–11

There is therefore now no condemnation. I have read that line for years as a verdict handed down at a distance. This month it read as something closer — a door held open by someone standing in it.

The chapter keeps returning to what the Spirit does rather than what I manage.

Verses 12–27

Groaning is the word Paul reaches for three times: creation, us, the Spirit. Not despair. The sound of something straining toward a shape it has not reached yet.

I want to sit with that longer than a week.
